title: Soft Sensor for Bottom-Hole Pressure Estimation in Petroleum Wells Using Long Short-Term Memory and Transfer Learning
abstract: arXiv:2602.03737v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Monitoring bottom-hole variables in petroleum wells is essential for production optimization, safety, and emissions reduction. Permanent Downhole Gauges (PDGs) provide real-time pressure data but face reliability and cost issues. We propose a machine learning-based soft sensor to estimate flowing Bottom-Hole Pressure (BHP) using wellhead and topside measurements. A Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model is introduced and compared with Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) and Ridge Regression. We also pioneer Transfer Learning for adapting models across operational environments. Tested on real offshore datasets from Brazil's Pre-salt basin, the methodology achieved Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) consistently below 2\%, outperforming benchmarks. This work offers a cost-effective, accurate alternative to physical sensors, with broad applicability across diverse reservoir and flow conditions.

translated_title: 基于长短期记忆网络与迁移学习的石油井井底压力估计软测量方法
translated_abstract: 监测石油井中的井底变量对于生产优化、安全保障和减排至关重要。永久性井下压力计（PDG）虽能提供实时压力数据，但存在可靠性和成本方面的问题。本文提出一种基于机器学习的软测量方法，利用井口和地面测量数据来估计流动井底压力（BHP）。研究引入了长短期记忆（LSTM）模型，并与多层感知器（MLP）和岭回归进行了对比。此外，该研究还率先采用迁移学习方法，使模型能够适应不同的作业环境。在巴西盐下盆地的真实海上数据集上进行测试，该方法的平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）始终低于2%，优于基准方法。这项工作为物理传感器提供了一种经济、准确的替代方案，可广泛适用于不同的储层和流动条件。
tldr: 该论文提出一种结合LSTM和迁移学习的软测量方法，通过井口数据估计石油井井底压力，在真实海上数据集上实现低于2%的MAPE，为昂贵的井下物理传感器提供了经济且准确的替代方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LSTM-based soft sensor with pioneering transfer learning to estimate bottom-hole pressure from wellhead measurements, achieving MAPE consistently below 2% on real offshore datasets and offering a cost-effective alternative to physical downhole gauges.
